ui.description: Native Candle/MLX additive LoRA on the undistilled dense FLUX.3 Klein base. Edit pairs require exactly one reference per target. No quantized training, activation checkpointing or in-training previews. Resume unchanged runs from the queue; duplicate starts a separate run. Source JSON is forwarded under flux3 only; unknown keys are refused. Source controls include caption_dropout, max_sequence_length, center_crop, random_flip, weighting_scheme, logit_mean, logit_std, mode_scale, max_grad_norm, lr_scheduler, lr_num_cycles and lr_power.
ui.label: FLUX.3 Klein Base LoRA

ui.description: Train Iris-3B generation: a LoRA or LoKr adapter, or a full fine-tune from the released weights or from random init. Pixel-space flow matching on the frozen Qwen3-VL text encoder, on Apple Silicon (MLX) and NVIDIA (Candle/CUDA).
ui.label: Iris 3B

memoryFloors.basis: Floors are GiB (2^30 bytes), judged against the device's capacity in GiB (a "96 GB" NVIDIA card is 95.59 GiB; an MLX floor is judged against unified memory minus the macOS/app reserve). Keyed by artifact and training resolution; `full_ac` is a full fine-tune under full activation checkpointing. Measured rows are the whole-process peak of a real full fine-tune at batch 1, converted to GiB, plus a 2 GiB reserve. MLX peaks are the ACTIVE peak with MLX's buffer cache disabled; production runs keep the cache, so a process footprint can rise to the allocator's GC ceiling (0.95 × the recommended working set) without that being need. Candle peaks are the live pool peak over six optimizer steps (steady from step 2) on a 95.59 GiB card; a row marked measured_spill is a need the run met only by spilling to system memory, so it does not fit that card. Each row carries its own provenance. Measured at the row's own shape: mlx full 512; mlx full 1024; mlx full_ac 1024; candle full 512; candle full_ac 512; candle full_ac 1024. Measured need that did not fit the measuring device (completed only by spilling to system memory): candle full 1024. Extrapolated from measured rows: mlx full 256; mlx full_ac 256; mlx full_ac 512; candle full 256; candle full_ac 256. Declared, not measured: mlx adapter 256; mlx adapter 512; mlx adapter 1024; candle adapter 256; candle adapter 512; candle adapter 1024. A machine under its floor is refused before the model loads, and a shape above the last row is refused rather than admitted without a bound.

ui.description: Fine-tune Iris-3B monocular depth on aligned RGB + numerical depth (+ validity mask) examples — the paper's recipe (full fine-tune, masked L1 + gradient loss, AdamW 3e-5). Writes a depth model you can pick in the Image Editor and Library depth actions. Apple Silicon (MLX) and NVIDIA (Candle/CUDA).
ui.label: Iris 3B Depth

memoryFloors.basis: Floors are GiB (2^30 bytes), judged against the device's capacity in GiB (a "96 GB" NVIDIA card is 95.59 GiB; an MLX floor is judged against unified memory minus the macOS/app reserve). Keyed by the pixels of one micro-batch (batch size × training height × width); `full_ac` holds the rows of a run under gradient (activation) checkpointing on the lanes that implement it. Evidence is the whole-process peak of a real full fine-tune of the 3B depth model at batch 1, converted to GiB, plus a 2 GiB reserve. MLX peaks are the ACTIVE peak with MLX's buffer cache disabled; production runs keep the cache, so a process footprint can rise to the allocator's GC ceiling (0.95 × the recommended working set) without that being need. Candle peaks are the live pool peak over six optimizer steps (steady from step 2) on a 95.59 GiB card; a row marked measured_spill is a need the run met only by spilling to system memory, so it does not fit that card. Each row carries its own provenance. Measured at the row's own shape: mlx 262144; mlx 1048576; mlx full_ac 1048576; candle 262144; candle full_ac 1048576. Measured need that did not fit the measuring device (completed only by spilling to system memory): candle 1048576. Extrapolated from measured rows: mlx 16384; mlx 307200; mlx 589824; mlx full_ac 16384; mlx full_ac 262144; mlx full_ac 307200; mlx full_ac 589824; candle 307200; candle 589824; candle full_ac 262144; candle full_ac 307200; candle full_ac 589824. Declared, not measured: candle 16384; candle full_ac 16384. A machine under its floor is refused before the model loads, and a shape above the last row is refused rather than admitted without a bound.

ui.description: Fine-tune Iris-3B restoration with the paper's adversarial recipe (pixel + LPIPS + ConvNeXt-critic GAN loss): a full fine-tune by default, or a LoRA / LoKr merged into the export. Train on clean images (reproducible synthetic degradation) or on aligned degraded/clean pairs. Writes a restoration model you can pick wherever Iris restores. Apple Silicon (MLX) and NVIDIA (Candle/CUDA).
ui.label: Iris 3B Restoration

Each row carries its own provenance. Measured at the row's own shape: mlx full 262144; mlx full_ac 262144; mlx full_ac 1048576; candle full 65536; candle full 262144; candle full_ac 1048576. Measured need that did not fit the measuring device (completed only by spilling to system memory): candle full 1048576. Extrapolated from measured rows: mlx full 65536; mlx full_ac 65536; candle full_ac 65536; candle full_ac 262144. Declared above a measured lower bound: mlx full 1048576.
